Content.SourceString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>队长权限</>
队长拥有审批队员、请离队员、转让队长、修改战队信息的权限

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>副队长权限</>
副队长的数量上限为2名，由队长任命
副队长拥有审批队员、请离队员的权限

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>队长未活跃自动转让队长</>
队长如果未登录超过14天，则队长身份会优先转让给活跃且功勋更高的副队长，其次转让给功勋更高且活跃的队员
Content.LocalizedString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Leader Rights</>
The leader can approve members, remove members, transfer leadership, and edit Union details.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Deputy Leader Rights</>
The leader can appoint up to 2 deputy leaders.
Deputies can approve and remove members.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Automatic Leader Transfer</>
If the leader is inactive for over 14 days, leadership will first transfer to the active deputy leader with the highest merit, and then to the active member with the next highest merit.

Content.SourceString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>战队功勋、经验获取方式</>
1、和战队队员组队匹配，可获得战队功勋。根据玩法模式和胜负关系不同，获得的功勋数量不同
2、参与赛事对局，可获得战队功勋。根据对局结果，获得数量不同。
3、若对局判定存在消极游戏等违规行为，对局不可获得战队功勋。
4、引航者获得的战队功勋，都会按照1比1的比例转化为战队经验。

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>每周战队经验的获取有上限</>
战队每周仅可获得一定量的战队经验，达到上限后不再获取战队经验。
每周一凌晨6点重置。

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>等级奖励</>
战队等级解锁的奖励，需要玩家在当前战队至少获取一定量的战队功勋才可领取。越高等级奖励所需战队功勋越多。
[记忆序列]、[弦列维度礼盒]、[经验加成卡]为一次性奖励，领取后更换战队无法重复领取。
[勋章]、[基板]、[封装]为战队特权奖励，退出战队后会失去使用权。

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>战队未活跃的等级惩罚</>
战队内所有队员超过7天未上线时，每日凌晨6点扣除战队经验，直到队员上线后停止。
Content.LocalizedString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Earning Union Merit and EXP</>
1. Play matches with your Union to earn Union Merit. The amount depends on the mode and match outcome.
2. Participate in tournaments to earn Union Merit. The amount depends on the match outcome.
3. If negative behavior is detected in a match, Union Merit will not be awarded.
4. Any Union Merit earned will convert to Union EXP at a 1:1 ratio.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Weekly Union EXP Limit</>
Union EXP earned each week is capped. Once the limit is reached, no more Union EXP can be earned.
Resets every Monday at 6:00 AM.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Level Rewards</>
1. Earn the required amount of Union Merit in your current Union to claim level rewards.
2. Memory Sequences, Dimension Boxes, and EXP Bonus Cards are one-time rewards. Once claimed, they cannot be reclaimed by switching Unions.
3. Medals, player cards, and cases are Union privilege rewards and cannot be used if you leave the Union.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Union Inactivity Penalty</>
If all Union members have been offline for more than 7 days, Union EXP will be deducted daily at 6:00 AM until a member logs in.

Content.SourceString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>额外的账号经验值</>
和战队队员组队匹配，可获得额外的账号经验值。
根据战队队员组队人数，加成比例不同。

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>每周加成有上限</>
和战队队员组队匹配，每周最多可获得一定量的额外账号经验值。
每周一凌晨6点重置。
Content.LocalizedString:
<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Bonus Account EXP</>
Team up with Union members to earn bonus EXP.
The bonus varies based on the number of Union members.

<CommonRulePopUp_18_Blod>Weekly Bonus Cap</>
Teaming with Union members can earn you a limited amount of extra EXP each week.
Resets every Monday at 6 AM.

Content.SourceString: 战区将决定您当前可选择的网络节点。为了保证良好的网络连接体验和游戏环境，不支持随时更换战区。
Content.LocalizedString: Servers determine your current network node. To ensure a stable connection and optimal gameplay, you can't switch servers frequently.

Content.SourceString:
{1}规则说明：
1.购买礼盒后，将自动开启礼盒。
2.礼盒内每个道具获取概率均不同。
3.礼盒内所有道具都有""可获得次数"",可获得次数为0的道具不会再次获得,同时获得其他道具的概率将会提升。
4.如果您已经拥有了礼盒内的部分独特道具,您购买此礼盒不会重复获得此独特道具。
5.所有道具全部被抽取后，礼盒将被转化成 {2} *{3}。
6.道具概率最多显示为百分比后两位小数。
Content.LocalizedString:
{1} Rules:
1. After purchasing a gift box, it will automatically open.
2. Every item in the gift box has different drop rates.
3. Each item has a "limited obtainable count." Items with zero count left won't be drawn again, increasing the drop rates for other items of the same Quality.
4. If you already own unique items from the gift box, you will not receive duplicates.
5. When all items are drawn, the gift box converts to {2} *{3}.
6. Item drop rates are shown up to two decimal places.

Content.SourceString:
{1}规则说明：
1.购买礼盒后，将自动开启礼盒。
2.礼盒内每个道具获取概率均不同。
3.礼盒内所有道具都有""可获得次数"",可获得次数为0的道具不会再次获得,同时获得同品质其他道具的概率将会提升。
4.礼盒内同一品质的道具全部获得后,其他品质的获取概率会对应提升。
5.如果您已经拥有了礼盒内的部分独特道具,您购买此礼盒不会重复获得此独特道具。
6.所有道具全部被抽取后，礼盒将被转化成 {2} *{3}。
7.道具概率最多显示为百分比后两位小数。
Content.LocalizedString:
{1} Rules:
1. The gift box opens automatically upon purchase.
2. Each item in the gift box has its own drop rate.
3. Every item has a limited "obtainable count." Once an item's count reaches zero, it will no longer drop, and the drop rates for other items of the same Quality will increase.
4. When all items of a certain Quality are obtained, drop rates for items of other Qualities will increase.
5. If you already own a unique item from the gift box, you won't receive it again.
6. Once all items have been drawn, the gift box will be converted into {2} *{3}.
7. Drop rates are displayed to two decimal places.

Content.SourceString: 开局以五人为一组，共计三组队伍参与乱斗。
Content.LocalizedString: The match begins with three teams of five players each.

Content.SourceString: 在对局中，打出伤害、击杀敌人或治疗队友都能让头升级变大。
Content.LocalizedString: Dealing damage, defeating enemies, or healing teammates will make your head grow larger.

Content.SourceString: 在决战阶段，成为“大头王”后仅可使用近战武器，全员的重生机制不再生效。
Content.LocalizedString: In the Final Showdown, as the "Bobblehead King," you can only use melee weapons, and respawning is disabled for everyone.

Content.SourceString: 获胜回合数排名靠前的队伍赢得胜利。
Content.LocalizedString: The team with the highest number of winning rounds achieves victory.

Content.SourceString: 开局会随机指定几名超弦体为炸弹人。
Content.LocalizedString: At the start of the match, several players are randomly chosen as Bomb Carriers.

Content.SourceString: 炸弹人可以通过近战攻击对手来传递炸弹。
Content.LocalizedString: Bomb Carriers can pass the bomb to opponents through melee attacks.

Content.SourceString: 炸弹在一段时间后或回合结束时会发生爆炸，淘汰携带炸弹的玩家。
Content.LocalizedString: The bomb will explode after some time or at the end of the round, eliminating the player carrying it.

Content.SourceString: 每回合的幸存者可以获得积分，累计积分排名高的玩家获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: Survivors earn points each round, and the player with the highest total points wins.

Content.SourceString: 无限团竞比拼的是团队实力，你将和队友们并肩作战。
Content.LocalizedString: Team Arena tests your team's strength, where you'll fight alongside your teammates.

Content.SourceString: 组队行动是个好主意，因为落单的人很容易遭到“群殴”。
Content.LocalizedString: Sticking together is wise since lone players are easy targets for a "gang-up."

Content.SourceString: 当你见到重复角色时，不用惊慌，游戏机制提供了这种选择。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't panic if you encounter duplicate Superstring Agents; the game design allows for this choice.

Content.SourceString: 最后，别忘了告诉队友，团队的“胜利目标”是尽快击败指定数量的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: Finally, remind your teammates that to win, you must defeat the required number of enemies quickly.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-爆破入侵
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Demolition

Content.SourceString: 熟悉地图的布局、包点位置和重要路线是入门的第一步。
Content.LocalizedString: Understanding the map layout, bomb sites, and key routes is your first step to mastering this mode.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是进攻方，那就需要掩护携带装置的队友进入包点，完成安装任务。
Content.LocalizedString: As the attacker, you need to cover the teammate carrying the bomb as they enter the bomb site and plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 携带装置的队友一旦倒下了，装置就会原地掉落。
Content.LocalizedString: If the teammate carrying the bomb goes down, it will be dropped at their current location.

Content.SourceString: 装置安装完毕后，要继续保持警惕，而不是提前庆祝。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay alert after planting the bomb; don't celebrate too early.

Content.SourceString: 因为只有坚持到装置引爆或者敌人全部倒下，才算获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: Victory is only achieved when the bomb detonates or all enemies are eliminated.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是防守方，可以记住这两个获胜秘诀，一是在下包前消灭全部的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're a defender, remember these two winning tips: First, eliminate all enemies before they plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 二是在倒计时结束前，拆除装置。
Content.LocalizedString: Second, defuse the device before the timer runs out.

Content.SourceString: 此外，双方打满规定的局数后，会交换攻防位置。
Content.LocalizedString: After a set number of rounds, the two sides will switch roles.

Content.SourceString: 最终，先拿下指定分数的队伍就是赢家。
Content.LocalizedString: The team that reaches the target score first wins.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-极限推进
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Escort

Content.SourceString: 进攻方的任务是在规定时间内，沿着路线将运载目标推送到终点。
Content.LocalizedString: Attackers must escort the payload along the route to the destination in time.

Content.SourceString: 防守方的任务是在路途中拦截运载目标，消灭敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: Defenders must intercept the payload and eliminate enemies in its path.

Content.SourceString: 需要注意的是只有当进攻方待在运载目标附近，才能实现有效推进。
Content.LocalizedString: Note that the attackers can only push the payload when they stay close to it.

Content.SourceString: 并且，该运载目标支持四面弦化贴墙和自由滑行。
Content.LocalizedString: Additionally, you can stringify and stick to the sides of the payload.

Content.SourceString: 这些规则你都学会了，胜利就不难了。
Content.LocalizedString: Master these rules, and victory will be yours.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-晶源感染
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Outbreak

Content.SourceString: 开局会随机指定数名玩家为晶源体，并且被他们击败的超弦体也会立即感染成晶源体。
Content.LocalizedString: At the start, several players are randomly chosen as Crystallines, and any defeated Superstrings will immediately mutate into Crystallines.

Content.SourceString: 在对局中，超弦体和晶源体均可获得补给物资和抽卡机会。
Content.LocalizedString: During the match, both Superstrings and Crystallines can receive supplies and draw cards.

Content.SourceString: 晶源体死亡会再次复活，唯有进化后使用近战武器可以将他们彻底消灭。
Content.LocalizedString: Crystallines can respawn after death. Only evolved Melee Weapons can eliminate them permanently.

Content.SourceString: 超弦体方胜利条件为：至少有一人存活到比赛结束。
Content.LocalizedString: Superstring wins if at least one member survives until the end.

Content.SourceString: 晶源体方胜利条件为：把全部超弦体感染为晶源体。
Content.LocalizedString: Crystalline wins by infecting all Superstrings.

Content.SourceString: 弦区争夺需要团队配合，双方围绕弦区进行争夺对抗。
Content.LocalizedString: Conquest demands teamwork, with both sides battling over control.

Content.SourceString: 开局会自动生成弦能溢出区域，并且弦区的位置会随着时间的推移发生变化。
Content.LocalizedString: The game automatically generates String Energy overflow zones, and the location of String Zones changes over time.

Content.SourceString: 双方队伍都需要通过驱逐敌方来争夺弦区的控制权，确保独占弦区后即可获得积分。
Content.LocalizedString: Both teams must oust the enemy to control the zone; secure it exclusively to score points.

Content.SourceString: 当队伍遇到与建筑结构相融合的弦区时，可通过贴墙来进行占领操作。
Content.LocalizedString: When a team encounters a String Zone integrated with a building, use Wall-Stick to capture it.

Content.SourceString: 最终，累计积分先达到上限的队伍获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: The first team to reach the target score wins.

Content.SourceString: 团队乱斗是以多人小队的形式协同作战。
Content.LocalizedString: Squad collaboration is key in Team Deathmatch.

Content.SourceString: 你若是想要冲突重围，枪法和身法缺一不可。
Content.LocalizedString: To survive the onslaught, you must have good aim and movement.

Content.SourceString: 可以尽量避开多个枪线的攻击，选择“趁乱偷袭”的策略。
Content.LocalizedString: Try to avoid getting caught in the crossfire. Strike your targets amidst the chaos.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟你的“胜利目标”是尽快击败指定数量的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, eliminating the required number of enemies is the only way to win.

Content.SourceString: 在刀战模式下，每把近战武器有着不同的攻击效果，可按需选择。
Content.LocalizedString: In Sword Clash, each melee weapon offers unique abilities. Pick what suits your strategy.

Content.SourceString: 近战攻击方式存在克制关系：格挡可以抵御重击，重击克制轻击，格挡无法抵御轻击。
Content.LocalizedString: Melee attacks follow a counter system: Blocks can defend against heavy attacks, heavy attacks overpower light ones, and blocks can't defend against light attacks.

Content.SourceString: 能量槽充满后，超弦体可进入强化形态：移速增加，伤害减免，重击的冷却时间减半。
Content.LocalizedString: Once the energy bar is full, the Superstring enters an enhanced mode: increased movement speed, reduced damage taken, and halved cooldown for heavy attacks.

Content.SourceString: 击败人数最快达到指定上限的队伍获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: The first team to reach the target number of kills wins.

Content.LocalizedString: At the start of the match, several players are randomly chosen as Bomb Carriers.

Content.SourceString: 炸弹人可以通过近战攻击对手来传递炸弹。
Content.LocalizedString: Bomb Carriers can pass the bomb to opponents through melee attacks.

Content.SourceString: 炸弹在一段时间后或回合结束时会发生爆炸，淘汰携带炸弹的玩家。
Content.LocalizedString: The bomb will explode after some time or at the end of the round, eliminating the player carrying it.

Content.SourceString: 每回合的幸存者可以获得积分，累计积分排名高的玩家获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: Survivors earn points each round, and the player with the highest total points wins.

Content.SourceString: 无限团竞比拼的是团队实力，你将和队友们并肩作战。
Content.LocalizedString: Team Arena tests your team's strength, where you'll fight alongside your teammates.

Content.SourceString: 组队行动是个好主意，因为落单的人很容易遭到“群殴”。
Content.LocalizedString: Sticking together is wise since lone players are easy targets for a "gang-up."

Content.SourceString: 当你见到重复角色时，不用惊慌，游戏机制提供了这种选择。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't panic if you encounter duplicate Superstring Agents; the game design allows for this choice.

Content.SourceString: 最后，别忘了告诉队友，团队的“胜利目标”是尽快击败指定数量的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: Finally, remind your teammates that to win, you must defeat the required number of enemies quickly.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-爆破入侵
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Demolition

Content.SourceString: 熟悉地图的布局、包点位置和重要路线是入门的第一步。
Content.LocalizedString: Understanding the map layout, bomb sites, and key routes is your first step to mastering this mode.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是进攻方，那就需要掩护携带装置的队友进入包点，完成安装任务。
Content.LocalizedString: As the attacker, you need to cover the teammate carrying the bomb as they enter the bomb site and plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 携带装置的队友一旦倒下了，装置就会原地掉落。
Content.LocalizedString: If the teammate carrying the bomb goes down, it will be dropped at their current location.

Content.SourceString: 装置安装完毕后，要继续保持警惕，而不是提前庆祝。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay alert after planting the bomb; don't celebrate too early.

Content.SourceString: 因为只有坚持到装置引爆或者敌人全部倒下，才算获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: Victory is only achieved when the bomb detonates or all enemies are eliminated.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是防守方，可以记住这两个获胜秘诀，一是在下包前消灭全部的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're a defender, remember these two winning tips: First, eliminate all enemies before they plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 二是在倒计时结束前，拆除装置。
Content.LocalizedString: Second, defuse the device before the timer runs out.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-极限推进
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Escort

Content.SourceString: 进攻方的任务是在规定时间内，沿着路线将运载目标推送到终点。
Content.LocalizedString: Attackers must escort the payload along the route to the destination in time.

Content.SourceString: 防守方的任务是在路途中拦截运载目标，消灭敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: Defenders must intercept the payload and eliminate enemies in its path.

Content.SourceString: 需要注意的是只有当进攻方待在运载目标附近，才能实现有效推进。
Content.LocalizedString: Note that the attackers can only push the payload when they stay close to it.

Content.SourceString: 并且，该运载目标支持四面弦化贴墙和自由滑行。
Content.LocalizedString: Additionally, you can stringify and stick to the sides of the payload.

Content.SourceString: 这些规则你都学会了，胜利就不难了。
Content.LocalizedString: Master these rules, and victory will be yours.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-晶源感染
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Outbreak

Content.SourceString: 开局会随机指定数名玩家为晶源体，并且被他们击败的超弦体也会立即感染成晶源体。
Content.LocalizedString: At the start, several players are randomly chosen as Crystallines, and any defeated Superstrings will immediately mutate into Crystallines.

Content.SourceString: 在对局中，超弦体和晶源体均可获得补给物资和抽卡机会。
Content.LocalizedString: During the match, both Superstrings and Crystallines can receive supplies and draw cards.

Content.SourceString: 晶源体死亡会再次复活，唯有进化后使用近战武器可以将他们彻底消灭。
Content.LocalizedString: Crystallines can respawn after death. Only evolved Melee Weapons can eliminate them permanently.

Content.SourceString: 超弦体方胜利条件为：至少有一人存活到比赛结束。
Content.LocalizedString: Superstring wins if at least one member survives until the end.

Content.SourceString: 晶源体方胜利条件为：把全部超弦体感染为晶源体。
Content.LocalizedString: Crystalline wins by infecting all Superstrings.

Content.SourceString: 弦区争夺需要团队配合，双方围绕弦区进行争夺对抗。
Content.LocalizedString: Conquest demands teamwork, with both sides battling over control.

Content.SourceString: 开局会自动生成弦能溢出区域，并且弦区的位置会随着时间的推移发生变化。
Content.LocalizedString: The game automatically generates String Energy overflow zones, and the location of String Zones changes over time.

Content.SourceString: 双方队伍都需要通过驱逐敌方来争夺弦区的控制权，确保独占弦区后即可获得积分。
Content.LocalizedString: Both teams must oust the enemy to control the zone; secure it exclusively to score points.

Content.SourceString: 当队伍遇到与建筑结构相融合的弦区时，可通过贴墙来进行占领操作。
Content.LocalizedString: When a team encounters a String Zone integrated with a building, use Wall-Stick to capture it.

Content.SourceString: 最终，累计积分先达到上限的队伍获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: The first team to reach the target score wins.

Content.SourceString: 团队乱斗是以多人小队的形式协同作战。
Content.LocalizedString: Squad collaboration is key in Team Deathmatch.

Content.SourceString: 你若是想要冲突重围，枪法和身法缺一不可。
Content.LocalizedString: To survive the onslaught, you must have good aim and movement.

Content.SourceString: 可以尽量避开多个枪线的攻击，选择“趁乱偷袭”的策略。
Content.LocalizedString: Try to avoid getting caught in the crossfire. Strike your targets amidst the chaos.

Content.SourceString: 毕竟你的“胜利目标”是尽快击败指定数量的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: After all, eliminating the required number of enemies is the only way to win.

Content.SourceString: 新手教学-排位爆破
Content.LocalizedString: Tutorial - Demolition

Content.SourceString: 熟悉地图的布局、包点位置和重要路线是入门的第一步。
Content.LocalizedString: Understanding the map layout, bomb sites, and key routes is your first step to mastering this mode.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是进攻方，那就需要掩护携带装置的队友进入包点，完成安装任务。
Content.LocalizedString: As the attacker, you need to cover the teammate carrying the bomb as they enter the bomb site and plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 携带装置的队友一旦倒下了，装置就会原地掉落。
Content.LocalizedString: If the teammate carrying the bomb goes down, it will be dropped at their current location.

Content.SourceString: 装置安装完毕后，要继续保持警惕，而不是提前庆祝。
Content.LocalizedString: Stay alert after planting the bomb; don't celebrate too early.

Content.SourceString: 因为只有坚持到装置引爆或者敌人全部倒下，才算获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: Victory is only achieved when the bomb detonates or all enemies are eliminated.

Content.SourceString: 如果你是防守方，可以记住这两个获胜秘诀，一是在下包前消灭全部的敌人。
Content.LocalizedString: If you're a defender, remember these two winning tips: First, eliminate all enemies before they plant the bomb.

Content.SourceString: 二是在倒计时结束前，拆除装置。
Content.LocalizedString: Second, defuse the device before the timer runs out.

Content.SourceString: 此外，双方打满规定的局数后，会交换攻防位置。
Content.LocalizedString: After a set number of rounds, the two sides will switch roles.

Content.SourceString: 最终，先拿下指定分数的队伍就是赢家。
Content.LocalizedString: The team that reaches the target score first wins.

Content.SourceString: 在刀战模式下，每把近战武器有着不同的攻击效果，可按需选择。
Content.LocalizedString: In Sword Clash, each melee weapon offers unique abilities. Pick what suits your strategy.

Content.SourceString: 近战攻击方式存在克制关系：格挡可以抵御重击，重击克制轻击，格挡无法抵御轻击。
Content.LocalizedString: Melee attacks follow a counter system: Blocks can defend against heavy attacks, heavy attacks overpower light ones, and blocks can't defend against light attacks.

Content.SourceString: 能量槽充满后，超弦体可进入强化形态：移速增加，伤害减免，重击的冷却时间减半。
Content.LocalizedString: Once the energy bar is full, the Superstring enters an enhanced mode: increased movement speed, reduced damage taken, and halved cooldown for heavy attacks.

Content.SourceString: 击败人数最快达到指定上限的队伍获胜。
Content.LocalizedString: The first team to reach the target number of kills wins.

Content.SourceString:
<Black14>定向重构:</>
引航者可以使用“<Red>重定向序列</>”，<Red>永久解锁并切换往期的意识重构</>，获取您想要的外观奖励。选择完成后，定向重构奖励将会随之切换。您可以随时选择并切换，您已经解锁的往期意识重构，此解锁项不会随着定向重构更新而消失。
如果您选择了“混合卡池”（未使用“重定向序列”时默认为此选项），没有选择某期意识重构，你将会随机获得此次定向重构中有可能获得的奖励。
此选择不会影响您进行复现时，获得奖励的品质概率。进行复现时，不会出现您已经获得过的传说级外观、不会出现已经获得过2次的完美级外观，除非您已经获得了此次活动中全部的传说级、完美级奖励。
<Black14>复现概率:</>
【传说】基础概率<Red>0.65%</>,综合概率(含保底)<Red>1.7%</>,最多<Red>80</>次复现必定获得传说级外观。在您复现时，如果出现了传说级外观，则<Red>必定</>为您选择的当期意识重构的限定外观。若本次复现获得的传说级外观为当期角色时装,下次复现获得的传说级外观必定为当期武器外观,获得当期传说级武器外观时同理。
当期传说级角色时装、武器外观均获得后，将会随机获得此次定向重构中其他意识重构，您还没有获取过的传说级外观。
如果您已经获得了本次定向重构中，所有的传说级外观，此机制不保留。
【完美】基础概率<Red>5%</>,综合概率(含保底)<Red>5.8%</>,最多30次复现必定获得<Red>完美级</>或以上外观。同时完美级外观最多重复2次(直到完美级外观全部抽齐为止)
当期完美级角色时装、武器外观均获得2次（或当期完美级外观全部抽齐）后，将会随机获得此次定向重构中其他意识重构，您还没有获取过超过2次的完美级外观。
如果您已经获得了本次定向重构中，所有的完美级外观，此机制不保留。
【卓越】基础概率<Red>24%</>,综合概率(含保底)<Red>24.3%</>
【精致】基础概率<Red>70.4%</>,综合概率(含保底)<Red>68.2%</>
<Black14>重复获得外观:</>
重复获得外观时,将转化为基弦
<Black14>保底机制:</>
普通奖池保底计数、定向重构奖池保底计数可以相互继承。
<Black14>限定物品:</>
带"限定"标记的物品,仅在特定奖池中获得,无其他获取途径。
Content.LocalizedString:
<Black14>Reconstruction:</>
Use <Red>Directed Sequence</> to choose your preferred <Red>Reconstruction Pool</>. Rewards update instantly with your selection. You can change pools anytime, and unlocked pools won't disappear with Reconstruction updates.
If you choose the Mixed Pool (default option without Directed Sequence) and don't select a specific Reconstruction, you'll randomly get rewards from the current pool. This won't affect the odds of different reward qualities. You won't receive Legendary skins you already own or Epic skins obtained twice unless you've acquired all Legendary and Epic rewards from this event.

<Black14>Draw Rate:</>
Legendary: Base chance <Red>0.65%</>, overall (with guarantee) <Red>1.7%</>. Guaranteed within <Red>80</> draws. If a Legendary skin appears, it will <Red>definitely</> be your chosen exclusive from the current Reconstruction. If your current Legendary drop is a Superstring Outfit, the next will be a Weapon Skin, and vice versa. After obtaining both the current Legendary Outfit and Weapon Skin, you'll randomly get other unclaimed Legendary skins. This stops if you've acquired all the current Legendary skins.
Epic: Base chance <Red>5%</>, overall (with guarantee) <Red>5.8%</>. Guaranteed Epic or better within <Red>30</> draws. Epic skins may duplicate up to 2 times until all are collected. Once you have both the current Epic Outfit and Weapon Skin twice (or all Epic skins), you'll randomly receive other unclaimed Epic skins up to twice. This stops if you've collected all current Epic skins.
Rare: Base chance <Red>24%</>, overall <Red>24.3%</>.
Refined: Base chance <Red>70.4%</>, overall <Red>68.2%</>.

<Black14>Duplicate Skins:</>
Duplicate skins will convert into Basestrings.

<Black14>Guarantee Mechanism:</>
Guarantee counters from Standard Prize Pools and Reconstruction Prize Pools carry over between each other.

<Black14>Limited Item:</>
Items marked "Limited" are only available in specific prize pools and cannot be obtained by other means.

Content.SourceString:
通过此前桎化行动中与晶源体的接触，人类基本确定了晶源体的发生地处于希达半岛深处，想要扫清晶源体威胁就必须完成对希达半岛的防御布控和战略纵深建设。
为了完成希达半岛的战略部署，三方势力进行了联合，并拟定了一个庞大的作战方案，本次行动则是作为整个作战方案的第一环节，由数个精锐小队在希达半岛的各个战略驳接区域完成既定战术目标，从而查清晶源体的深度动向。
作战计划分为四个小型目标：
一、以晶源体高发地为攻略阵地，对晶源体的数量进行遏制，并进一步获取晶源体的数据，制造针对性杀伤武器；
二、获取并更新晶源体相关的历史研究文献与记录，明确晶源体来源，寻找控制性方案的可能；
三、针对晶源体产生的集群化战略转变迹象，推测可能存在高等领导者，需要排除干扰项目，确定是否存在斩首目标，以便调整下一步的战略方向。
四、通过杀伤有生目标，逼迫高等领导暴露自己的作战位置，执行斩首作战。
<Black14>活动时间</>
{StartFullTime} ~ {EndFullTime}
<Black14>活动规则</>
1、活动期间，引航者可以完成【行动纲要】中的任务，获取【超弦固辐剂】，任务每周刷新；
2、引航者可以在活动页面中选择任意地区协助超弦体调查，消耗【超弦固辐剂】后可获取线索，解锁线索后可获得理想币奖励及【模因盒】；
3、当收集了一个地区中的全部线索后，引航者可以解锁对应地区的【区域纪实】，了解地区故事，获取基弦和大量【模因盒】奖励；
4、引航者可以在【行动补给】中消耗【模因盒】兑换奖励。
Content.LocalizedString:
Based on encounters with the Crystallines during the prior Operation Restraint, we have confirmed their place of origin lies deep within the Seeda Peninsula. To eliminate this threat, we must establish comprehensive defensive measures and strategic depth across the Peninsula.

To facilitate this strategic deployment, the three major factions have formed a coalition and drafted an extensive operational plan. The current mission serves as the initial phase of this grand strategy, deploying several elite units to secure key tactical positions throughout the Peninsula. The primary objective is to uncover the Crystallines' deeper intentions.
This plan includes four key objectives:
1. Target high-density Crystalline zones to limit their numbers, gather data, and develop tailored weapons.
2. Acquire and update historical research on the Crystallines to seek control solutions.
3. Investigate signs of Crystalline strategic clustering for possible high-level leaders. Identify decapitation targets to adjust strategy.
4. Force high-level leaders to reveal their positions by eliminating key targets.

<Black14>Event Duration</>
{StartFullTime} ~ {EndFullTime}

<Black14>Event Rules</>
1. During the event, Navigators can complete quests in the Operation Brief to earn Stabilizers, with quests refreshing weekly.
2. Navigators can assist in Superstring investigations by consuming Stabilizers to obtain Clues, unlocking Dream Tokens and Energy Matrices.
3. Upon collecting all Clues in a region, unlock Area Reports to learn its story and earn Basestrings and a large amount of Energy Matrices.
4. In the Operation Supplies, Navigators can exchange Energy Matrices for rewards.
